mostWorthwhile.text: Cooling the gas envelope made the formation process most understandable: losing energy lets it contract and accept more gas.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive gas-envelope steps felt a little repetitive, though each added a useful detail.

surprise.text: I was surprised that gathering more gas depends on the envelope first losing energy and contracting.

arbitrary.text: Using open space to cool the envelope was a somewhat abstract combination, although the radiative cooling result explained its purpose.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the contrast between early and late core growth made the planetary outcomes informative, and I am curious about the gas giant’s interaction with icy planetesimals.
